## API etiquette
- `/api/*` exists for the live site UI. Cache ≥ 60s. Do not burst or scrape.
- On HTTP 429, honor `Retry-After`. Do not retry in a tight loop.
- Coin stats are also on Dexscreener, GeckoTerminal, CoinGecko, and stocktokenswap.com — use those for research bots.
- Same-origin browser traffic from strategycoin.io is welcomed.

## Do not
- Probe `.php`, WordPress, `cgi-bin`, `.env`, or admin paths (this is a Next.js app).
- Attempt RCE / CGI / path-traversal payloads.
- Hammer cron, card, or swap-adjacent endpoints.
